## Source.
Page 39. Table "CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF EARNINGS." Numbers in thousands (header says "(in thousands, except per share amounts)").

## Values.
"Operating earnings" row. 2023: $106,712 thousand. 2022: $68,544 thousand.

## Formula.
Percentage change = (2023 - 2022) / 2022 x 100.

## Source and EBIT values.
Page 63, "Consolidated Statements of Operations." Numbers in thousands. Operating income for December 30, 2023: $8,268 thousand. Operating income for December 31, 2022: $17,933 thousand.

## Depreciation and amortization values.
Page 67, "Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows." Numbers in thousands. D&A for December 30, 2023: $31,039 thousand. D&A for December 31, 2022: $23,047 thousand.

## EBITDA calculation.
EBITDA = Operating Income + D&A. For 2023: 8,268 + 31,039 = $39,307 thousand. For 2022: 17,933 + 23,047 = $40,980 thousand.

## Percentage change.
(39,307 - 40,980) / 40,980 x 100. Numerator: negative 1,673. Result: negative 1,673 divided by 40,980 times 100 equals negative 4.08%.

## The data.
Page 43, "Stock Price Performance Graph." Data table below the chart tracks $100 investments. Six date columns ending with 7/31/2022.

## PANW.
Page 43 table, row "Palo Alto Networks, Inc.," date 7/31/2022: $378.74. Return from $100: 278.74%.

## S&P IT.
Page 42 table, row "S&P Information Technology Index," date 7/31/2022: $257.30. Return from $100: 157.30%.

## Financial statement.
Page 97. Table name: "DIGITAL REALTY TRUST, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES CONSOLIDATED INCOME STATEMENTS." Units are in thousands except per share data. Year 2024: total operating revenues = $5,554,968 thousand. Operating income = $471,864 thousand.

## 2025 revenues.
Revenues increase 40%. 5,554,968 x 1.40 = $7,776,955.2 thousand.

## 2025 operating margin.
Margin increases by 8 percentage points. 8.4944% + 8% = 16.4944%.

## 2025 operating income.
7,776,955.2 x 0.164944 = $1,282,770.068 thousand, which is $1,282,770,068 to the nearest dollar.

## Note on page 139.
Document page 139. "Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements." One of the notes discusses the Adimab Collaboration Agreement.

## 2021 number.
Page 139, second paragraph of the Adimab note, last sentence: "For the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2021, the Company recognized $5.2 million and $2.6 million, respectively, of research and development expense related to the quarterly fee." The 2021 value is $2.6 million.

## 2022 number.
Same sentence on page 139. The 2022 value is $5.2 million.

## Percentage increase.
(5.2 - 2.6) / 2.6 x 100. That is 2.6 / 2.6 x 100. Result: 100.00%.

## Net income location.
Page 24 of the Eaton 10-K 2023. Table: Consolidated Statements of Income. The 2023 net income attributable to Eaton ordinary shareholders is $3,218 million.

## Total assets.
Page 26 of the same document. Table: Consolidated Balance Sheets. 2023 total assets: $38,432 million. 2022 total assets: $35,014 million.

## Average.
38,432 + 35,014 = 73,446. 73,446 / 2 = $36,723 million average total assets.

## Extracting operating loss and tax benefit.
Document page 63, "Consolidated Statements of Operations," December 31, 2023 column. Numbers in millions. Loss from operations: $314.9 million. Loss before income taxes and equity in loss of unconsolidated entity: $317.2 million. Income tax benefit: $0.4 million.

## Computing NOPAT.
Effective tax rate = 0.4 / 317.2 = 0.0013, or 0.13%. NOPAT = loss from operations times (1 minus effective tax rate). NOPAT = negative 314.9 times (1 minus 0.0013) = negative 314.9 times 0.9987 = negative $314.5 million.

## Balance sheet components.
Document page 62, "Consolidated Balance Sheets," December 31, 2023 column. Numbers in millions. Concierge credit facility: $24.8 million. Current operating lease liabilities: $98.9 million. Non-current operating lease liabilities: $410.2 million. Cash and cash equivalents: $166.9 million. Total stockholders' equity: $432.0 million.

## Computing invested capital.
Debt and lease liabilities: 24.8 + 98.9 + 410.2 = $533.9 million. Net of cash: 533.9 minus 166.9 = $367.0 million. Invested capital: 367.0 plus 432.0 = $799.0 million.

## ROIC.
ROIC = NOPAT / invested capital = negative 314.5 / 799.0 = negative 0.393 = negative 39.3%.

## Source data.
Pages 47-48. Operating income $580 million. Depreciation $156 million. Amortization $31 million.

## EBITDA and debt.
EBITDA: 580 + 156 + 31 = $767 million. Total debt: $1,184 million. Debt-to-EBITDA: 1,184 / 767 = 1.54.

## Hypothetical debt reduction.
Page 51. Stock repurchases in 2020: $736 million. 50% directed to debt: $368 million. New debt: 1,184 - 368 = $816 million. EBITDA unchanged at $767 million (interest is below EBITDA).

## Improvement.
New ratio: 816 / 767 = 1.06. Old ratio: 1.54. Improvement: (1.54 - 1.06) / 1.54 x 100 = 31.16883117%.

## Income statement.
Page 52. Table: "Alliant Energy Corporation Consolidated Statements of Income."

## Operating income.
Line 17, page 52. EBIT (operating income) for Alliant was $886 million.

## Tax rate.
Income tax line on page 52, 2024 Consolidated Statements of Income. Income tax benefit: $(114) million. Income before income taxes: $576 million. Effective tax rate: negative 114 / 576 = negative 0.1979, or negative 19.79%.

## NOPAT.
NOPAT = EBIT x (1 minus effective tax rate). NOPAT = $886 million x (1 minus negative 0.1979). That is $886 million x 1.1979. Result: $1,061.35 million.

## Current liabilities.

Working capital = current assets minus current liabilities. 826.5 minus 872.8 = $(46.3) million.

## HEICO FY2018 operating income.
Page 23. Table "Results of Operations." Units: thousands. Below the table, "Operating Income by segment:" section. "Total Operating Income" row: $376,245 thousand.

## R&D location.
Page 24. "Gross Profit and Operating Expenses" section. R&D expense for fiscal 2018 was $57.5 million, included in cost of sales.

## Scenario: $10 million R&D cut.
$10 million less R&D expense reduces cost of sales by $10 million. Operating income rises by $10,000 thousand.

## Scenario: 5pp margin boost.

376,245 + 10,000 + 500 = $386,745 thousand. In millions: $386.745 million. Rounded: $386.7 million.

## Balance sheet pages.
Pages 82 and 83 of the Check Point document. Table title: "CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS (CONT'D)." Covers years ended December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023.

Page 82, bottom of table, "Total Assets," 2024 column: $5,754.5 million.

## Total liabilities.
Page 83, "Total liabilities," 2024 column: $2,963.5675 million. Total liabilities and shareholders' equity (same as total assets): $5,754.5 million.

## Liability increase.
A 10% increase in total assets means total assets grow by 5,754.5 times 0.10, which is $575.45 million. The liability-to-assets ratio stays the same. Liability share: 2,963.5675 / 5,754.5 = 0.515014. Liabilities increase by 575.45 times 0.515014 equals $296.35675 million.

## Source data.
Page 71 (footer 67). "Comcast Corporation Consolidated Statement of Income." Numbers in millions. Year 2018. Operating income: $19,009 million. Depreciation: $8,281 million. Amortization: $2,736 million. Revenue: $94,507 million.

## Expense lines.
Programming and production: $29,692 million. Other operating and administrative: $28,094 million. Advertising, marketing and promotion: $7,036 million. Other operating gains: $(341) million.

## Adjusted depreciation.
Depreciation drops 10%. 8,281 x 0.90 = $7,452.9 million.

## Adjusted amortization.
Amortization rises 5%. 2,736 x 1.05 = $2,872.8 million.

## New operating income.
Total costs: 29,692 + 28,094 + 7,036 + 7,452.9 + 2,872.8 - 341 = $74,806.7 million. Operating income: 94,507 - 74,806.7 = $19,700.3 million, which rounds to $19,700 million.

## Note C, segment data.
Howmet Aerospace 2024 Form 10-K, Note C, "Segment and Geographic Area Information," page 52 for the operating table. Page 84 for the detailed sales table. Numbers in millions of dollars.

## 2024 third-party sales.
Page 84 table. Engine Products: $3,735 million. Fastening Systems: $1,576 million. Engineered Structures: $1,065 million. Forged Wheels: $1,054 million.

## Engine Products 2025.
10% growth applied to $3,735 million. 3,735 x 1.10 = $4,108.5 million.

## Forged Wheels 2025.
5% decline applied to $1,054 million. 1,054 x 0.95 = $1,001.3 million.

## Other two segments.
Fastening Systems stays at $1,576 million. Engineered Structures stays at $1,065 million.

## Page 39.
"COMPARISON OF CUMULATIVE TOTAL RETURN*" chart. $100 investment started August 5, 2020.

## Reading S&P 500 in Dec-2023.
S&P 500 line at Dec-2023: about $150. Return: 50%.

## Annual rate.
August 2020 to December 2023 is roughly 3.33 years. Factor: 1.50^(1/3.33) = 1.1295 per year.

## Extend to December 2024.
August 2020 to December 2024 = about 4.4 years. 1.1295^4.4 = approximately 1.71.

## Source.
Page 37. "Consolidated Balance Sheets." Amounts in thousands.

## Summing liabilities.
Current liabilities: accounts payable 64,102, current LTD 70,689, current op lease 29,998, accrued 43,062, insurance 25,464, due to affiliates 20,737, income taxes 6,364. Non-current: LTD net 311,235, op lease non-current 63,620, deferred tax 79,567, other 6,487.

## Total.
721,325 thousand.

## Starting total liabilities.
Consolidated Balance Sheet on page 62. Total liabilities at December 31, 2022: $311,424,585.

## Remove duplicate accounts payable.
Accounts payable - related parties was entered twice. Remove $1,200,000. Running total: 311,424,585 - 1,200,000 = $310,224,585.

## Remove repaid lines of credit.
$1,750,000 in lines of credit was repaid in December. Subtract $1,750,000. Running total: 310,224,585 - 1,750,000 = $308,474,585.

## Reclassify financing lease liabilities.
Move $3,500,000 of financing lease liabilities from current to non-current. This is a reclassification only and does not change total liabilities. Running total: $308,474,585.

## Reduce overstated operating lease.
Current portion of operating lease liabilities was overstated by $5,200,000. Subtract $5,200,000. Running total: 308,474,585 - 5,200,000 = $303,274,585.

## Add understated deferred tax.
Deferred tax liabilities were understated by $4,000,000. Add $4,000,000. Final total: 303,274,585 + 4,000,000 = $307,274,585.

## Source.
Page 152. "WD-40 COMPANY - CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS (In thousands, except per share amounts)."

## Adjusted net sales.
2023 net sales: $537,255 thousand. After 4% increase: 537,255 x 1.04 = $558,745.2 thousand.

## Adjusted COGS.
2023 cost of products sold: $263,035 thousand. COGS ratio: 263,035 / 537,255 = 0.4895. Adjusted COGS: 0.4895 x 558,745.2 = $273,505.7754 thousand.

## Adjusted operating expenses.
2023 SG&A: $154,684 thousand. After 6% increase: 154,684 x 1.06 = $163,965.04 thousand. Advertising and promotion: $28,807 thousand (unchanged). Amortization of intangibles: $1,005 thousand (unchanged). Total: 163,965.04 + 28,807 + 1,005 = $193,777 thousand (approximately).

## Adjusted operating income.
285,239.4246 - 193,777 = $91,462.4246 thousand.

## Adjusted pre-tax income.
Interest income: $231 thousand. Interest expense: $5,614 thousand. Other income (expense) net: $822 thousand. Pre-tax: 91,462.4246 + 231 + 822 - 5,614 = $86,901.4246 thousand.

## Effective tax rate.
2023 pre-tax income: $85,163 thousand. 2023 income tax: $19,170 thousand. Rate: 19,170 / 85,163 = 0.2251 or 22.51%.

## Adjusted net income.
Taxes on adjusted pre-tax: 0.2251 x 86,901.4246 = $19,552.8119 thousand. Net income: 86,901.4246 - 19,552.8119 = $67,348.6041 thousand.

## Page 58, Atkore.
"ATKORE INC. CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS." Numbers in thousands.

## Two SG&A values.
Row "Selling, general and administrative." September 30, 2024 column: 397,544. September 30, 2023 column: 388,206. All in thousands.

## Computing the change.
397,544 - 388,206 = 9,338 thousand. That is how much it went up.

## Converting to percent.
9,338 / 388,206 = 0.02405. Times 100 = 2.41%.

## Balance sheet.
Page 1 of the document. Table "CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS." Numbers in thousands.

## Values.
December 31, 2020 column. Total shareholders' equity: $364,761 thousand ($364,761,000). Treasury stock: negative $183,161 thousand (negative $183,161,000). Total assets: $1,188,990 thousand ($1,188,990,000).

## Adjusted equity.
Treasury stock is already deducted in reported equity. To add it back: 364,761 + 183,161 = $547,922 thousand.

## The chart.
Page 28. "Comparison of Cumulative Total Return." The graph starts at June 28, 2019 with a $100 investment and dividends reinvested. Three lines in the chart.

## WOLF data from the table.
6/28/2020: WOLF = $102.78. 6/25/2023: WOLF = $88.01.

## WOLF CAGR.
88.01 / 102.78 = 0.8563. To the power of 1/3: 0.9496. Minus 1 = negative 5.04%.

## Philly semi data from the table.
6/28/2020: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index = $134.13. 6/25/2023: $254.85.

## Philly semi CAGR.
254.85 / 134.13 = 1.90. To the power of 1/3: 1.2386. Minus 1 = 23.86%.

## Delta.
WOLF CAGR minus Philadelphia CAGR: negative 5.04% minus 23.86% = negative 28.9%.

Section: "Net unit sales were as follows." The table has a column for 2020 and a column for 2019.
